fieldValues.policy_explanation: Careful work inside a working group: the smallest reversible version, with its assumptions written down, reviewed by the group instead of the owner. The group's reviewer judges the assumptions; anything outside the group's mandate still escalates to the owner as a proposed decision.
care_must: write an assumptions block in the PR
put open questions as blocks: merge asks
leave the gate to the group's reviewer: no gate: label at opening
